No network operations, dynamic downloads, or executable code generation occur during the build or install phase.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, unexpected file operations, or data exfiltration. All actions are consistent with standard packaging practices for LaTeX templates in the AUR. The license is permissive (MIT), and dependencies are legitimate TeX packages. No scripts are executed beyond standard file installation.
